title: Hapoel Tel Aviv are crowned 24/25 champions!
description: Gran Canaria - H.Tel-Aviv 94-103 Hapoel Tel Aviv are crowned EuroCup champions. They beat Gran Canaria on the road to sweep the championship series., Gran Canaria trailed by 12 points after 3 quarters before a 20-17 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 94-103 at the end of the game. H.Tel-Aviv shot the lights out from three sinking 15 long-distance shots on high 57.7 percentage. 26 personal fouls committed by Gran Canaria helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American guard Antonio Blakeney (193-1996, college: LSU) orchestrated the victory by scoring 27 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. The other American import center Johnathan Motley (207-1995, college: Baylor) contributed with 26 points for the winners.
